body:
### Summary

On x86_64 macOS, `uv python list` does not list Python 3.14.8, the latest stable release. Running `uv python install 3` also does not select this version. However, explicitly specifying the version with `uv python install 3.14.8` successfully installs it.

Steps to reproduce:

1. Run `uv python list` and observe that Python 3.14.8 is missing.
2. Run `uv python install 3` and observe that it does not select Python 3.14.8.
3. Run `uv python install 3.14.8` and observe that installation succeeds.

Expected behavior: `uv python list` should include Python 3.14.8, and `uv python install 3` should select it as the latest stable Python 3 release available for this platform.

```bash
~
➜ uv python list
cpython-3.14.7-macos-x86_64-none    .local/bin/python3.14 -> .local/share/uv/python/cpython-3.14.7-macos-x86_64-none/bin/python3.14
cpython-3.14.7-macos-x86_64-none    .local/share/uv/python/cpython-3.14-macos-x86_64-none/bin/python3.14
cpython-3.8.20-macos-x86_64-none    .local/bin/python3.8 -> .local/share/uv/python/cpython-3.8.20-macos-x86_64-none/bin/python3.8
cpython-3.8.20-macos-x86_64-none    .local/share/uv/python/cpython-3.8-macos-x86_64-none/bin/python3.8
~
➜ uv python install 3
Python 3 is already installed
~
➜ uv python install 3.14
Python 3.14 is already installed
~
➜ uv python install 3.14.8
cpython-3.14.8-macos-x86_64-none (download) ------------------------------ 1.10 MiB/25.61 MiB
...
```

### Platform

macOS 14.8.9

### Version

0.12.23 (46b84fd0b 2026-10-03 x86_64-apple-darwin)

### Python version

3.14.8
title: Python 3.14.8 missing from `uv python list` on x86_64 macOS with `python-downloads = "manual"`
